title: HomeView Sentinel control state, version 1
description: Written by the control agent to ~/Library/Application Support/HomeView Sentinel/control/state.json (temporary file and rename, mode 0600) on every change and at least every 5 seconds. A written_at older than 15 seconds means the agent is not running. Times are UTC; clients show them in local time. Holds no credentials.

mode.description: off, 24/7 (always), or a timed watch until `until`.

until.description: End of a timed watch; null for off and always.

phase.description: What the components are doing: starting from a request until the detector and every camera are online (or 2 minutes), stopping until every component is unloaded.

detail.description: In Portuguese: the problem when phase is problem, otherwise why the last request was refused, or null.

power.description: The Mac's power source. On battery the Mac may sleep while watching.

kept_awake.description: Whether the Mac is being kept from idle sleep (watching on power adapter).

durations_hours.description: The timed watch durations the agent accepts, for clients to offer.

applied_request.description: Id of the last request applied.

refused_request.description: Id of the last request refused ("unknown" when it had no readable id); `detail` says why.

last_alert.description: The most recent dwell.started, as the phone showed it; null when there is none or its snapshot was deleted.
